The conflict in Gaza persists with heavy impacts on infrastructure and civilians, while security incidents in the Gulf and Lebanon keep the risk of wider escalation elevated.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, an intensification of diplomatic rhetoric between Iran and the West and ongoing negotiations over the Israeli government coalition are expected. The security situation will remain tense with risks of localized escalation.
